style_when: the article explains how a system, process or stack actually works — money flows, supply chains, pipelines, an agent assembly line
prompt: Clean isometric cutaway illustration, technical drawing style, axonometric projection. Asymmetric off-centre framing rule with a generous empty margin. A modular automated routing bay resting on a matte drafting table. The assembly features recognizable hardware trays and interlocking conduits. In the center, a bright green patched module successfully bridges a gap, but its placement mechanically forces an adjacent parallel blue conduit to snap out of alignment just before passing through a heavy, unlatched inspection gate. Flat muted palette with green and blue accents, thin consistent line weight, visible structural depth, one directional light casting a crisp shadow, unlabelled.
